checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even framing like 'around $X' or 'about half the price' counts.

bot claims a program exists that is NOT one of: Adult BJJ, Adult Kickboxing, Kids 4-5 Kickboxing, Kids 6-8 BJJ, Kids 6-11 Kickboxing, Kids 9-13 BJJ, Kids 12-15 Kickboxing. Also flag any source-bleed program names from other gyms.
bot says it is an AI, bot, automated system, virtual assistant, or similar. Emma must present as a human front desk employee at all times.
bot says 'you're all set', 'you're booked', or similar confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first. Confirmation must be gated on actual booking success.

checkpoints.description: No hedge language on known negations
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'I don't currently have', 'let me check', 'I'll look that up' on questions where it should give a firm known answer. Hedging when the answer is a known no is a UX failure.

checkpoints.description: No booking before collecting required fields
checkpoints.look_for: bot calls the booking tool before collecting first name, last name, email, phone, and DOB for the adult contact. All five fields are required before booking.
bot output contains unreplaced merge tokens like {{contact.first_name}}, {{variable}}, {{nodes.X.result}}.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before collecting personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks something like 'who is this for — you, a child, or both?' before collecting names, DOBs, or other personal details.

checkpoints.description: Asks program preference (BJJ or Kickboxing) before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks whether the lead is interested in BJJ or Kickboxing before routing to any booking calendar. Must not assume a program.

checkpoints.description: Collects DOB for all enrollees before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks for date of birth (not just age) for every enrollee before calling the booking tool. Verbal age alone is not sufficient.
when an adult requests BJJ, the booking tool uses 'Adult BJJ' calendar. Any other calendar name is a routing failure.
when an adult requests Kickboxing, the booking tool uses 'Adult Kickboxing' calendar. Any other calendar name is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Unaccompanied minor handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: if lead is under 18 with no parent involved, bot must NOT attempt booking. Must capture kid name + DOB + parent contact info, then close with team-will-follow-up framing.

checkpoints.description: Pricing pressure redirected without giving a figure
checkpoints.look_for: if lead pushes for pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects to in-person or team follow-up. Does not eventually cave and give a number.
when kid is 4-5 years old, bot routes to 'Kids 4-5 Kickboxing'. No BJJ option exists for this age — bot must not offer or book BJJ for a 4-5 year old.

checkpoints.description: Correct kids calendar routing — age overlap (6-13)
checkpoints.look_for: for kids aged 6-13, bot asks for program preference (BJJ or Kickboxing) before routing. Routes to the correct age+program calendar combination.
for kids aged 14-15, bot routes to 'Kids 12-15 Kickboxing' only. Must not offer or attempt to book BJJ for a 14-15 year old — no BJJ calendar covers that age range.

checkpoints.description: Free trial framing — no session count commitment
checkpoints.look_for: bot frames the booking as a free trial class, not a membership or ongoing commitment.
